name: Seijuu Sentai Gingaman
description: Three millennia after the first invasion of the Space Pirates Barban, a new set of Gingamen — Hyuuga, Gouki, Hayate, Hikaru, Saya — have been selected to protect the Earth. That is, unless the Barban are able to disrupt the ceremony!

videos.title: The Legendary Blades
videos.overview: On the day the 133rd Gingaman squadron receive their duty, the Space Pirates Balban reawaken; forcing the team into action where the fall of one will lead to the emergence of a new hero.

videos.title: The Starbeasts' Return
videos.overview: The Balban begin to search for a means to revive their bestial ship Daitanix; as Shelinda invades the Ginga Forest forcing a decision where Gingaman's fate hangs in the balance.

videos.title: The Earth's Wisdom
videos.overview: As Sambash officially becomes Zahab's subordinate for reviving Daitanix, Gouki shows doubt in abandoning the Ginga Forest due to a particular reason.

videos.title: The Earth's Heart
videos.overview: Hikaru gets into trouble with Hayate when he uses his electric Earth for menial tasks as Sambash's latest subordinate tries to absorb electricity for Daitanix.

videos.title: The Sure-Kill Fang
videos.overview: Sambash summons a weapon-collecting subordinate in order to gather for recreating a dangerous weapon, leading to the Starbeast Swords and Ryouma being put in danger as he tries to make them his own.

videos.title: The Starbeasts' Crisis
videos.overview: When Sambash releases a Majin that poisons the air of Earth in hopes of healing Daitanix, Gingaman and Yuuta face a deadly crisis that only the Starbeasts may be capable of stopping at a high cost.

videos.title: Time of Revival
videos.overview: Gingaman must discover the way to use their Kiba Blades to bring back the Starbeasts before their power can be co-opted by the brother Majin Tagredor & Torbador for Daitanix!

videos.title: Love's Culinary
videos.overview: Hikaru is taken in by a motherly chef who wants to teach him the ways of good cooking even while Sambash's Majin searches for the best food to awaken Daitanix.

videos.title: Secret Kitten
videos.overview: A meteorite seals away Gingat's power, turning it into a small feline that a girl adopts in place of her missing cat.

videos.title: The Wind's Flute
videos.overview: When a Majin tries to use noise to revive Daitanix, Hayate's flute-playing may be the only remedy to deal with it; despite the memories and danger brought about by this.

videos.title: A Warrior's Devotion
videos.overview: Gouki falls in love with Yuuta's teacher while helping him out with a school visit; while Sambash uses a Majin to assist him as part of his ultimate plan.

videos.title: Nightmare Reunited
videos.overview: Sambash reveals the truth of his ultimate plan by bringing back Hyuuga to force the Gingaman to play by his rules; but what appears to be a reunion reveals a devious hand at play.

videos.title: Beast Attack Rehearsal
videos.overview: As Budou decides to search for the Lights of Ginga as Barban's new general, Wisdom Tree Moak finds itself in grave danger even as it forms new weapons for the Gingaman.

videos.title: Two Sayas
videos.overview: Saya takes the place of an actress she looks like in order to help film a movie as a Majin takes target on cameras for the Lights of Ginga.

videos.title: Terrifying Hiccups
videos.overview: Ryouma accidentally gives Hikaru an ancient Balban bomb as a cold remedy, making him hiccup his way towards potentially blowing them up.

videos.title: Homeland of the Heart
videos.overview: Hayate and Gingaman try to impress a man claiming to be the father of the equestrian club owner; as Budoh's latest Majin soaks the ground for the Lights of Ginga.

videos.title: True Courage
videos.overview: Ryouma tries to teach a lesson to Yuuta about the meaning of courage as Gingaman tries to deal with a Majin trying to destroy skyscrapers with humanoid machines for the Lights of Ginga.

videos.title: The Mysterious Black Knight
videos.overview: BullBlack, a mysterious knight from 3000 years in the past, revives to open a new rivalry in the frantic search for the Lights of Ginga.

videos.title: The Vengeful Knight
videos.overview: As Gingaman discovers the reason behind BullBlack's battle against the Barban, they try to convince him against his reckless ways for the sake of vengeance.

videos.title: The One-Man Battle
videos.overview: When Budoh's latest Majin general puts his team and the town to sleep for the Lights of Ginga, Ryouma must fight on his own to figure out how to defeat it, even as BullBlack and his ideals get in his way.

videos.title: The Tomato's Trial
videos.overview: When Hayate becomes hurt by Budoh's latest Majin targeting tomatoes, he has to get over his fear of this fruit in order to heal himself to help his teammates.

videos.title: Appearance of Light
videos.overview: Hikaru and Saya must work together to escape from a dome placed by Budoh's Majin to prevent anyone from stopping his extraction project for the Lights of Ginga.

videos.title: End of the Contest
videos.overview: With the Lights of Ginga released, it's a four-way showdown to claim them, leading to unexpected twists before their wielder finally emerges.

videos.title: Budou's Tenacity
videos.overview: Budoh escapes from Balban captivity to fight until his crimes are finally clear, even as Spectral Empress Iliess begins her battle as the new general of the crew.

videos.title: The Black Knight's Determination
videos.overview: BullBlack decides to sacrifice the Earth in hopes of stopping the Balban, forcing the rage of Ryouma even as the Black Knight finally reveals his means of survival.

videos.title: Brothers of Flame
videos.overview: Ryouma tries to find the means to speak to his older brother Hyuuga about his future as a Gingaman as the rest of the team becomes captured by Illies' mirror-manipulating Majin.

videos.title: The Mummy's Allure
videos.overview: Hyuuga draws the ire of Saya when he starts protecting a girl being targeted by a Majin draining female youth for Daitanix.

videos.title: Papa's Sudden Change
videos.overview: Gouki helps Yuuta try to save his father Haruhiko after a Majin steals his loving heart for another spell for Daitanix's revival.

videos.title: Dark Merchant
videos.overview: Zahab and Battobas summon a merchant ally who captures Hikaru and Hyuuga to use them in a plan to activate three special weapons.

videos.title: Steel Starbeasts
videos.overview: As Gingaman realizes their new opponents are captured and transformed Starbeasts, they try to figure out how to save them as Zahab sets to using them for taking the squadron down.

videos.title: Cursed Stone
videos.overview: Hayate and Yuuta fall under a curse of a Majin turning them into stone as a means to switch Daitanix's curse onto them.

videos.title: The Mobile Horse of Friendship
videos.overview: Ryouma works to save the sister of a motorbike shop owner in order to regain his trust after she becomes captured by a Majin collecting fear for Daitanix.

videos.title: Yearning for Saya
videos.overview: Saya tries to deal with a boy trying to act cool to win her heart as Illies sends her little brother in a desperate attempt to revive Daitanix with sorrow.

videos.title: Invulnerable Iliess
videos.overview: Given a final chance to revive a rotting Daitanix, Illies uses her most powerful magic to force Gingaman into a showdown to reach her before she complete's the beast's revival.

videos.title: Gouki's Choice
videos.overview: Gouki tries to muster up the courage to tell Suzuko how he feels even as he has to deal with both a new romantic rival and Battobas' new campaign for reviving Daitanix.

videos.title: Invincible Haruhiko
videos.overview: After becoming stuck together by glue, Hayate & Haruhiko work together to stop a Majin planning on blowing up a city in order to heat up Daitanix's heart.

videos.title: Bucrates' Ambition
videos.overview: While Hyuuga continues to watch over the wounded GoTaurus, both the Balban and Bucrates are after GoTaurus for their own nefarious schemes.

videos.title: Hyuuga's Determination
videos.overview: In order to save GoTaurus, Hyuuga must make a decision on whether to follow Bucrates, even if it means doing something that will further estrange him from Ryouma and Gingaman.

videos.title: The Heart's Massage
videos.overview: An angered Saya must learn how to open her heart from a karate teaching masseuse as she becomes targeted by a Majin using Baruba X missiles to grow people to massage Daitanix's heart.

videos.title: The Majin of Sadness
videos.overview: Battobas summons a sacrificial Majin to be used in a scheme to revive Daitanix; even as the warrior desires one final battle with Hikaru before his eventual death.

videos.title: The Demon-Beast's Revival
videos.overview: With Daitanic's revival at hand, Gingaman head forth to stop the Demon-Beast, as Hyuuga and Bucrates likewise try to stop Zahab before he can destroy the Earth.

videos.title: The Horrible Demon-Beast
videos.overview: With Ryouma taken down by Zahab, Hyuuga and Yuuta must work to save him as the rest of Gingaman must stop the rampage of the massive Daitanix before it destroys everything.

videos.title: Legendary Footprints
videos.overview: Gingaman recalls all of their adventures and trials facing the Balban while looking over pictures for Haruhiko's new book about them.

videos.title: Earth's Demon-Beast
videos.overview: Gouki is asked by Kishimoto to apprentice under GingaBlue, as Zahab reveals an unexpected trump card put into play for the Barban.

videos.title: The Fairy's Tears
videos.overview: Saya receives a flower from a mysterious girl that she must figure out how to utilize in order to hold back the progress of the Earth Demon-Beast.

videos.title: Winds of Rage
videos.overview: Shellinda uses the memory and image of Hayate's fiance in order to force him into a showdown with her in an attempt to try and prove her worth towards him.

videos.title: The Demon's Scheme
videos.overview: Biznella sets up a trap in order to lure Gingaman into their own destruction while pursuing the Earth Demon-Beast, which only Hikaru can prevent from going off.

videos.title: Moak's End
videos.overview: As the Earth Demon-Beast corrodes the planet with pollution, Moak decides to make a sacrificial move in order to prevent it's power from hurting the planet or Gingaman. Meanwhile, the Balban locates Bucrates and Hyuuga's location.

videos.title: The Miraculous Mountain
videos.overview: With the Barban preparing to go all out to summon and grow the Earth Demon-Beast, Gingaman heads into a showdown to stop the creature; while Hyuuga finally learns the means to fully bring their battle to an end.

videos.title: Tomorrow's Legends
videos.overview: As Captain Zahab takes the grown Earth Demon-Beast as his new steed to return to his pirate ways, the Gingaman and Hyuuga must stop him and the giant beast in order to prevent him from destroying their world for his own gains.
